summary: The OccHealthCovid19 system handles the management of student data related to COVID-19 health records, including data display, editing, saving, sorting, and filtering within a web application. It uses a grid interface to manage student enrollments and related data, providing functionalities to edit COVID-19 related status and dates, sort by different fields, filter records, and save changes either individually or in bulk.
purpose: The main purpose of the OccHealthCovid19 system is to facilitate the management and editing of student enrollments with respect to COVID-19 health records, providing a user interface to edit, save, sort and filter data related to COVID-19 immunization statuses and administration dates within an educational context.
